correctness.rationale: For every real edge-ℓ1 Möbius ladder with n>=10, averaging an arbitrary projection over its dihedral automorphisms preserves its image and cannot increase the norm. The incidence-kernel complement has a one-source-flow parameterization with two exact edge-column formulas. A coefficient-bounded signed supporting hyperplane yields 4H+V>=12-16/n for every reflection-antisymmetric chord array, with all variables canceling. Explicit rational arrays in n=10..16 and n>=17 give H=V=12/5-16/(5n). Rational checker reconstructs B, P²=P, BP=0 and column norms for n=10..18, evaluates symbolic formula for n=10..150. Infinite quantifier rests on direct algebra and inequalities, not finite tests.

value.rationale: The result determines an exact nonconstant Banach-space projection invariant for all nonplanar cubic Möbius ladders n>=10 with explicit global dual certificate and attaining projections. It establishes a surprising twist-insensitivity comparison with planar circular ladders despite nonisomorphic graph and circulation structures. This is a structural infinite-family extremal classification, not a finite isolated numerical calculation. It does not claim unique minimizers, smaller orders, weighted or complex generalizations.
